messages:
anya: Heads-up: runtime pushed a change that flips default batching to 'aggressive' and introduces a new quant profile. We need a short release note, migration steps, and SDK snippet updates (py + js). tagging @rachel and @samir for snippet + migration help.
rachel: Thanks, can someone paste the crisp user-facing bullets? I'll draft a 2-line relnote + examples.
samir: User bullets from runtime: 1) default `batching.policy` = "aggressive" for better throughput on long sequences; 2) new quant profile `q8-dynmix` available on x86-gpu images; 3) legacy profiles q4_0/q4_1 still work but are deprecated.
morgan: Note: in low-concurrency setups small-sequence latency can increase ~10-20ms under the new batching default. Add Known Issue and opt-out instructions.
anya: Snippets: update py example that used `batching=None` to show explicit opt-out `batching.policy = "none"`. Also show how to pin quant profile per-request.
rachel: Draft Python snippet: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(model="redwood-1-small", prompt=prompt, config={"batching": {"policy": "none"}, "quant_profile": "q4_1"})
```
rachel: Will add JS variant after wording approval.
samir: Migration doc additions: console/global opt-out steps, private-deploy CLI, per-route override examples. Also reference runtime kernel note at /docs/runtime/kernel-selection and check anchors.
docops-bot: Starting link-check (run id 4950).
docops-bot: Link-check complete (run id 4950) 10m  1 broken anchor found: kernel-selection.md#old-kernels -> should point to kernel-selection.md#kernel-selection. Filed docs issue #741.
rachel: I'll update the PR: add py/js snippets, Known Issue blurb, and fix the broken anchor. Draft relnote: "Default batching set to 'aggressive' to improve throughput for long-sequence workloads. If your feature relies on sub-100-token latency, you may see slightly higher tail latency; to restore previous behavior set `batching.policy: 'none'` in your client config or use a per-route override in Console."
samir: Add private deploy CLI example: ```bash
redwoodctl set global-config --batching.policy=none --quant_profile=q4_1
```
morgan: Add QA guidance: run representative perf suites (mix of seq lengths) before flipping flags. Tag Dedicated ops to stage canary rollouts.
anya: Action items: Rachel -> update PR with py/js snippets + Known Issue; Samir -> add migration CLI + private deploy instructions; Morgan -> ops rollout notes + Dedicated handbook mention; DocOps -> resolve docs#741 and re-run link checks. I'll merge relnote once snippets land and CI is green. :thumbsup:
